Title: For Victory and Peace

Verses.1:
Blessed be the LORD, my rock,
	who trains my hands for combat,
	and my fingers for battle.
Verses.2:
He is my ally, and my fortress,
	my stronghold, and my deliverer.
He is my shield, in whom I take refuge,
	who gives me power over my people.
Verses.3:
LORD, what are people that You care for them,
	or mere mortals that You think of them?
Verses.4:
Their life is like a breath,
	their days are like a passing shadow.
Verses.5:
LORD, bend down the heavens and come down;
	touch the mountains so that they smoke.
Verses.6:
Flash your lightening and scatter them,
	shoot your arrows and confuse them.
Verses.8:
whose mouths speak lies,
	and perjures the oath of their right hand.
Verses.9:
My God, a new song I will sing to you,
	on a ten-string harp, I will sing praises to you.
Verses.10:
You, who gives victory to kings,
	who rescues his servant David.
Verses.11:
Rescue me from the evil sword and set me free
	from the hand of foreigners,
whose mouths speak lies,
	and perjures the oath of their right hand.
Verses.12:
May our sons flourish in their youth
	like full-grown plants.
May our daughters be like strong pillars
	sculpted for the corners of a palace.
Verses.13:
May our granaries be filled
	with every kind of produce.
May our flocks increase by thousands,
	by tens of thousands, filling our countryside,
Verses.14:
and our cattle be fertile.
May there be no breach in our walls and no exile.
	May there be no cry of distress in our streets.
Verses.15:
Blessed are the people who are so favored!
	Blessed are the people whose God is the LORD!
